sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Rath is an Irish hero. In an Irish tale a sailor named Rath let a mermaid and her companions serenade him. The creatures then tore the man to pieces. Mermaids were not generally thought murderous, but a person had to avoid falling asleep to their Otherworldly music. They would steal humans away to become their lovers, as set out under Fairy Kidnapping.
